name: Visibility
why: Every repo of an org, from one audit run to public or private, each side checked
ideal: One run lists every repo; a private repo shows nothing signed out, and a public one holds no personal email and scans for secrets.

sources.title: GitHub Docs: changing the visibility of your GitHub Pages site
GitHub Docs: rate limits for the REST API

steps.name: List
steps.rule: One run lists every repo with its visibility and archived flag, never repo by repo.

steps.name: Probe
steps.rule: A private repo's Pages site is published privately, and a signed-out request does not load it.

steps.name: Scan
steps.rule: Public history carries only noreply or org author emails, on every branch, not the default alone.

steps.name: Decide
steps.rule: A repo stays public only with secret scanning and push protection on.

steps.name: Record
steps.rule: Each audit is one collect run on the Quality page, spending a tenth of the token's hourly requests.
